writeup: Woot has the Philips 7000 Series 2K dual-cam video doorbell (model DDA270X-2TXS, open box) for $58.19. Its second camera looks straight down to watch packages on the porch, and Philips' own store charges $161.99 even after a promo code, while StackSocial lists it at $200.59. That makes Woot's open-box unit about 64% less, with a limit of 2 per customer.
